items.title: Undo restores deleted pages, blocks, and schemas
items.summary: Deleted pages and blocks with inner refs come back intact, many-to-one undos no longer collapse, property schemas restore, and tag templates skip re-insert on redo.

items.title: UUID refs resolve in search and breadcrumbs
items.summary: Nested [[uuid]] titles render as page names in search, breadcrumbs, and page refs; missing entities stay broken links instead of failing the save.

items.title: Property pickers and config toggles stick
items.summary: Node property pickers show current selections, Hide-by-default and similar toggles persist, choice identities stay stable, and empty multi-value slots clear without throwing.

items.title: SPA HTML publishing no longer blanks
items.summary: Export public pages boots with content again after fixing worker startup and asset wiring in the published shell.

items.title: Desktop packaging and Windows installer
items.summary: Nightly desktop bundles include the embedding sidecar again, and electron-builder 26.17.0 stops the NSIS crash on Windows 11 24H2+.

items.title: Graph download survives bad assets
items.summary: A single failed asset download no longer aborts the whole graph download once the snapshot is already imported.

items.title: Settings recover from broken config.edn
items.summary: Missing or unparsable logseq/config.edn is recreated so settings toggles unlock again instead of staying stuck.

items.title: Flashcards, assets, and image actions
items.summary: Tags that extend Card count as flashcards, new assets land on #assets, and Electron Copy Image / Show in folder work again.

items.title: Moves keep descendants under ancestors
items.summary: Selecting an ancestor with descendants and dragging or Alt+Shift+Up no longer pulls grandchildren out of their parent.

items.title: Search, cmdk, and DB performance
items.summary: FTS lookups use rowid, cancelled search migrations stop early, Themes cmdk results stay populated, and WAL sync plus tree flush cut idle work.

items.title: Undo restores moves, deletes, tags, and properties
items.summary: Five undo bugs found by property-based testing now round-trip correctly, with regression coverage in the worker suite.

items.title: Safer paste of page refs and embeds
items.summary: Deduped pasted page refs that exploded into thousands of pages, bounded the batch-delete dialog, and fixed drag/paste of page embeds.

items.title: Editor composition and focus fixes
items.summary: Dead-key layouts no longer double characters, escape-editing clears only its own block, and the editor flushes before ref navigation.

items.title: Query builder and /query hardening
items.summary: Incomplete /query syntax no longer crashes the app; property chips show titles, custom status/priority appear in filters, and class defaults stay scoped.

items.title: Sync and checksum reliability
items.summary: Value replacements stay in one request, stale local checksums heal on graph open, and outliner insert identities survive sync replay.

items.title: Tag pages and views feel snappier
items.summary: Tag page bodies mount after the objects table paints, small class tables sort without a row-limit walk, and block render watches are indexed.

items.title: CLI markdown block upsert
items.summary: Upsert blocks accept Markdown via --blocks/--blocks-file, with clearer skill docs and healthier worker retirement during CLI runs.

items.title: Flashcards empty state and due count
items.summary: When no cards are due, practice-again is offered instead of the create-card empty state, and the due counter refreshes after rating.

items.title: Repeating dates and page updated-at
items.summary: Date repeats stay on the correct calendar day west of UTC, clearing datetimes drops stale journal refs, and page updated-at bumps on insert/move/delete.

items.title: Library moves and browser MCP
items.summary: Only normal pages move into Library with correct namespace roots, and Electron /mcp works from browser-based MCP clients.

items.title: Faster DB graph scans
items.summary: Cut several O(graph) paths in views, journals, refs, and startup revision checks so larger graphs stay responsive.

items.title: Snappier block editing
items.summary: Stopped re-rendering the editor box on every keystroke and sized the textarea with CSS field-sizing where supported.

items.title: More reliable DB worker
items.summary: Moved lock ownership to SQLite and keep the worker healthy across system sleep so graphs do not get stuck after idle.

items.title: Library and sidebar polish
items.summary: Hide library blocks, collapse nested pages more cleanly, and refresh favorites after drag-and-drop reorder.

items.title: Property paste and undo fixes
items.summary: Copy and paste text property values as blocks, restore property values after undo, and keep child page content on selection delete.

items.title: Query and table view fixes
items.summary: Fixed query result views and set-literal editing, restored property columns, and sped up DB table scrolling.

items.title: CLI and Windows build fixes
items.summary: Added force-remove page, username/password login, and fixed Windows vite/bundle and state-phase build issues.

items.title: Import and publishing fixes
items.summary: Convert markdown headings into DB heading metadata on import, and honor default home in HTML export.

items.title: Faster file-graph import
items.summary: Optimized the file graph import path and preserved mention timestamps, icons, and PDF annotations more reliably.

items.title: Page rename and delete edge cases
items.summary: Update linking page mirrors on rename, tag Recycle as Page so File→DB deletes work, and load breadcrumbs on demand.

items.title: Property and shortcut polish
items.summary: URL property editor UX, default Task status icons, shared default shortcuts when resetting, and Contents from the right-sidebar menu.
